# CRD groups discover:crds should never propose again.
# Matches a CRD's group or group/Kind, and the chart name or chart URL it came
# from. * and ? are globs: `*.example.com` drops a whole group suffix. Without a
# wildcard the whole string has to match, so `traefik.io` does not cover
# `traefik.containo.us`.
#
# Add an entry here whenever you close a find-crds issue for a group you do not
# want, otherwise the next run proposes it again.

# Superseded groups still running in old clusters
traefik.containo.us
